purpose: Specify the noise floor of the entire system (transducer + transport + sensor + reconstruction), which determines the smallest ICP change that can be reliably detected.

noise_sources.source: Transport variability (CSF flow pulsation, patient motion)

specification.system_noise_floor_mmhg: Target <= 3 mmHg (so that 5 mmHg ICP changes are detectable with >2x SNR)
specification.SNR_target_db: >= 20 dB for clinically meaningful ICP changes (>5 mmHg)

what_unfreezes_this: Steps 1-6. Each noise source must be characterized for the specific molecule + sensor combination.
validation_required: Bench: sensor noise in synthetic interstitial fluid (without molecule) — establishes baseline
Bench: sensor response to known molecule concentrations — establishes sensitivity + noise
In vivo (animal): sensor response to controlled ICP changes — validates end-to-end noise floor
status_provenance: MODEL_DERIVED from sensor physics + signal processing
